notes.title: MAiZE (Demo Version) v0.1.1 update
notes.notes:
This v0.1.1 update includes numerous fixes/new features including:


Various bug fixes to the Scarecrow/Pumpkimp functionalities, as well as the Dust Devil sound effect generating at the player start location.

Input Sensitivity is automatically adjusted depending on whether user is using a mouse or controller (sensitivity can still be adjusted manually via the settings menu as well)

Sanity Mechanic added to the game

Demonic Entity encounters now cause sanity damage

Sanity replenishes over time or by catching an Ophanim which appears and patrols the maze when the player's sanity HP falls under 50 points

Maximum sanity can be increased by collecting sage bushes hidden (1 sage bush per level, so the demo version only has 1 sage bush, whereas the full version will have 5 total)

An optional hints system has been added to the Player Options menu which will provide additional prompts with information on how to evade the game's various enemies.

The skybox for the first level has been updated to a sunset sky, and transitions to a dusk sky upon completion of the level (similar transitions will occur in the full version of the game for each level completion)


Update 7/5/25:There was an error in the directory setup for the build that was uploaded on 7-2, which has now been corrected. Apologies for any inconvenience/confusion!
